mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO virtual_wallet (wallet_id, user_id, balance, frozen_amount, create_time, update_time) VALUES (0, #{userId}, #{balance}, #{frozenAmount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE virtual_wallet SET wallet_id = id WHERE id = #{id} AND wallet_id = 0
UPDATE virtual_wallet SET frozen_amount = GREATEST(0, frozen_amount - #{amount}), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE virtual_wallet SET balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
